messages:

Cc: Neil Rivera <neil@oakridge.ai>
Date: 2026-05-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: hosting preference + region / timeline

Hi Michael —

Thanks for the demo last week. Our execs want to lock the MAP and confirm the deployment mode and region so we can align procurement and security. High-level: Oakridge prefers Dedicated in eu-west for data locality, but we need to validate performance/latency and confirm fallback options (hosted or private) in case of compliance edge cases.

Can you please:
- Confirm an evaluation approach (what to run in a PoC vs what you'd propose for a committed Dedicated rollout)
- Provide an estimated timeline to go from PoC -> Dedicated reservation (lead time, checkpoints)
- List what evidence we should include for our security review (SOC2/audit logs, region proof, KMS support)

Attached is our latest MAP workbook with milestones — updated with our target close: end of July.

[Attachment: Oakridge_MAP_v3.xlsx]

Thanks — looking to lock dates this week so procurement can start.

Best,
Alice Park
Head of Product, Oakridge AI

---

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Park <alice@oakridge.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-07T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: hosting preference + region / timeline

Alice — thanks for the note and the MAP workbook. Quick summary and proposed path that keeps your close target feasible: 

Recommendation (short):
1) Short hosted PoC in eu-west (2 weeks) to validate latency and prompt suite under realistic traffic.
2) Parallel security evidence handoff (we’ll populate SOC2 extracts, KMS flow, and audit-log sample).
3) Move to Dedicated reservation (reserved capacity) with a 4-week provisioning lead on eu-west GPUs; plan can be shortened via burst capacity for initial ramp.

Why hosted first: we can spin up a region-locked hosted instance within 24–48 hours for a scoped traffic replay. That gives you measurable p50/p95 latency and token cost numbers to compare against a Dedicated profile. If the PoC shows you meet latency and cost targets, we convert the MAP to a Dedicated commit and schedule provisioning.

Proposed timeline (rough):
- Week 0 (this week): Agree MAP milestones + sign mutual action plan (DocuSign link below).
- Week 1–2: Hosted PoC in eu-west (2 weeks) — Redwood provides a workload replay harness and token budget estimate.
- Week 2–3: Review PoC results; legal/procurement finalize SOW & PO for Dedicated.
- Week 4–6: Provision Dedicated pool and run acceptance tests; go-live on Dedicated by end of Week 6.

Security checklist (what we’ll provide):
- SOC 2 summary + SOC extracts per your request
- Audit-log samples and API-level access logs (time-limited extracts)
- KMS/HSM integration notes and key lifecycle docs
- Data residency diagram for eu-west tenancy

Attachments we’ll include in the handoff: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (extract), eu-west-deployment-diagram.png, provisioning-SLA-draft.pdf.

Action items:
- Alice: confirm you’re comfortable starting the hosted PoC and confirm the MAP workbook milestone dates.
- Karthik/Laura: please prepare the pricing anchor for a 12-month Dedicated commit + burst policy and populate the DocuSign SOW template.

DocuSign for the MAP: https://docusign.com/tx/abc-12345

Happy to jump on a 20-min call this afternoon for quick alignment.

Cheers,
Michael Grant
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Looping in ops/procurement details. Michael — good plan. A couple of clarifications we need from Oakridge before we lock the Dedicated anchor: 

- Committed throughput target (tokens/sec or requests/sec) so we can size the pool and show cost delta vs hosted.
- Required SLA tag: is 99.9% enough or do they need 99.95/99.99 for critical endpoints?
- Any drive for on-prem/private in the MAP that would change the timeline drastically? (if yes, provisioning windows are longer).

Pricing anchors (high level):
- Hosted PoC: complimentary with token cap for 2 weeks (we’ll bill overage).
- Dedicated reserve (12mo): baseline X GPUs + burst policy — I’ll send exact numbers after Oakridge confirms throughput target.

Laura — can you draft the 12-month pricing sheet and include an option for a shorter 6-month trial Dedicated commitment? Priyom — please prep the provisioning playbook for eu-west so we can quote a 4-week baseline plus a 1–2 week acceleration if they take burst.

I’ll also prepare a short packet for legal on typical exceptions customers ask for (data retention, audit access cadence).

Karthik

[Attachment: oakridge-security-questions.pdf]

- Michael/Karthik: send the hosted PoC runbook, token cap guidance, and pricing anchor for the 12mo Dedicated commit (include burst policy).
- Laura/Priyom: prepare provisioning timeline and acceptance-test checklist for eu-west.

We’ll book a 30-min review on Monday to review the PoC plan — will send a calendar invite. If all looks good, procurement will start routing the SOW immediately.

Best,
